conventions.worktree: one per task, from origin/main, via `git gtr new <branch> --from origin/main --yes` (verify with the guard in the working-in-worktrees skill); the flow-plugin task works in a branch of the dork-labs/marketplace checkout instead
conventions.review: adversarial review by a separate agent per REVIEW.md before the PR opens; fixes land; then PR
conventions.models: builders and reviewers: opus (mechanical work may use sonnet), effort high, never Fable
conventions.pr: branch named after the task slug; body `Closes DOR-<n>`; changelog fragment; OpenAPI regen when packages/shared/src/schemas.ts changes; real-browser or packaged-app proof in the PR body
